No Man's Sky is a tangle of incomplete story threads, half-finished game mechanics, and bugs that stretch over five years of feature creep.

Hello Games deserves praise for their patching, bug fixing, and vision. However, in the end, the game's many things you can do are all hollow, without a strong core gameplay to make it all fun.
